services.name: Morning Snorkel
services.desc: Key West is home to some of the most vibrant snorkeling in the United States, and Barefoot Billy’s makes it easy to experience it firsthand. Our snorkeling tours take you to the Florida Reef Tract, the third-largest living coral reef system in the world, where crystal-clear water and abundant marine life create unforgettable underwater views. Whether you’re a first-time snorkeler or a seasoned ocean explorer, our trips are designed to be fun, comfortable, and accessible for all experience levels. services.name: Boat Tours
services.desc: Key West sunsets are legendary and Barefoot Billy’s makes it easy to experience them from the water on one of our Key West’s signature sunset cruises. These relaxing sunset boat cruises in the Florida Keys offer stunning views as the sky fills with vibrant colors and the sun sinks below the horizon. Cruise along the coast, enjoy the ocean breeze and take in iconic sights during one of the most unforgettable experiences in Key West. Our sunset cruises all include open bar, delicious food and live music. Join us on Key West’s legendary sunset dinner cruise. This is a Key West staple and a must-do dinner reservation. services.name: 4-Hour Charter
services.desc: Your captain will find the perfect spot, bait the hooks, and yell “FISH ON!” When it’s time to reel them in! You fish as long as your family and friends like. Then it’s off to relax on the beach. If you decide to fish the entire time - even better! It’s your private charter, and Captain Max will take care of everything you need. Please allow at least 2 hours for sandbar portion of trip should you choose. Snorkel Gear: please call to provide fin size. Bring sunglasses, sunscreen, and wear your bathing suit. Your favorite food and beverage will complete your “Private Island Picnic”. Captain Max will find you fish then ice them down while you relax on the most remote beach you’ve ever seen.

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Key West is best explored by boat, and Barefoot Billy’s makes it easy to get out on the water your way. Our boat rentals give you the freedom to cruise the turquoise waters of the Florida Keys, discover hidden sandbars, anchor at quiet islands, or take in the sights along the coast at your own pace. With easy-to-operate boats and flexible rental options, it’s the perfect choice whether you’re planning a laid-back day on the water or an adventurous outing with friends and family. Looking to explore the crystal-clear waters of Key West without the stress of being the captain? Swap the helm for a cocktail and let us handle the navigation.
